analysis.title: Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) Earnings Review: 3Q26 OP inline with prelim; limited shareholder return details, but believe it's a matter of when not if; reiterate Buy (on CL)
key_insights: Samsung Electronics reported 3Q26 revenue of W195.3tn and operating profit of W107.4tn, in line with its pre-earnings guidance of W195tn/W107.4tn. NAND profit was slightly below GS expectations (slightly lower bit shipment and ASP), offset by smaller-than-feared smartphone losses from better product mix.

Company guided 4Q26 bit shipment growth of mid-to-high teens% qoq for DRAM and mid-teens% qoq for NAND, citing demand from new CPU/GPU platforms and expansion of agentic AI services. GS expects a record quarterly operating profit of W127tn in 4Q26E, up from W119tn previously.

Samsung reiterated that memory supply tightness will continue through 2027 and into 2028. Cited supply constraints are clean room limits, extended equipment lead times, rising construction costs and higher HBM trade ratios. The company said its higher 2027 capex intention should not meaningfully raise 2028 memory bit production.

HBM4 revenue grew more than 3x qoq in 3Q26, meeting the company's target, and HBM4 reached 60% of total HBM sales. GS estimates 3Q26 HBM revenue grew about 70% qoq to close to US$6bn, above the full-year 2025 total.
GS estimates HBM is still under 10% of Samsung's DRAM revenue. With +160% yoy HBM ASP growth next year, GS expects HBM's share of DRAM revenue to more than double to 20% in 2027.

Samsung expects remaining 2026 shareholder return funds of W55tn to W75tn, including a substantial buyback and cancellation program plus cash dividends. Execution details and the next shareholder return policy are to be finalized at the Board meeting scheduled for Jan. 2027.

Common shares fell 4% on the day against KOSPI -1%, which GS attributes to disappointment that no buyback was announced. GS expects a W70tn year-end shareholder return announced at the Jan. 2027 earnings call, made up of about W40tn cash dividends and about W30tn buyback and cancellation.

GS changed 2026E-28E EPS estimates by -1% to +4% on higher conventional DRAM and NAND shipment assumptions and higher HBM estimates. The 12m SOTP-based target price stays at W500,000 for common shares and W380,000 for preferred.
Valuation: common shares trade at 2.5X 2028E P/E and 1.0X 2028E P/B with 45% ROE. 12m forward P/B is 1.5X against 2026E/2027E ROE of 54%/58%, and 12m forward P/E is 3.2X.

GS DRAM assumptions: 2026E ASP US$1.7 per 1Gb equivalent (+295%), 2027E US$2.5 (+46%), 2028E US$2.4 (-4%). DRAM operating profit is W292.7tn in 2026E, W488.6tn in 2027E and W543.7tn in 2028E, at margins of 79%, 82% and 80%.
GS NAND assumptions: 2026E operating profit W91.6tn, 2027E W137.5tn, 2028E W134.0tn. NAND ASP is expected to fall 11% in 2028E.
Revised estimates: 2026E/2027E/2028E revenue W723.0tn/W1,029.9tn/W1,120.3tn and operating profit W381.4tn/W628.9tn/W686.7tn. 2027E operating profit rises 4.6% versus the prior forecast.
Within the 3Q26 mix, System LSI/Foundry lost W1.98tn. Mobile (MX/NW) posted a W0.60tn loss against GS's prior W1.27tn loss estimate. Display (SDC) earned W1.10tn and Harman W0.60tn.
GS expects long-term agreements with customers to support memory pricing, with a higher level of binding commitment than in the past.

market_movers.rationale: Samsung Electronics common (005930.KS): Buy on the conviction list (CL), 12m TP W500,000 unchanged, 115.5% upside from W232,000. Supported by memory fundamentals, HBM execution and an expected buyback.
Samsung Electronics preferred (005935.KS): Buy (CL), 12m TP W380,000 unchanged, 106.6% upside from W183,900. Uses a 24% preferred-to-common discount.

sector_views.rationale: AI server demand and limited supply growth are expected to keep memory tight through 2027 and 2028, with HBM mix rising.

earnings_insights: 3Q26 reported (10/30 review): revenue W195.3tn and operating profit W107.4tn, in line with the company's pre-earnings guidance of W195tn/W107.4tn.

3Q26 GS estimates versus the prior 3Q26P: DRAM sales W104.8tn vs W99.2tn prior (+5.6%), NAND sales W39.2tn vs W40.2tn prior (-2.5%), DRAM operating profit W81.8tn, NAND operating profit W26.8tn (-3.0% vs prior).
3Q26 GS-estimated EPS W11,453 versus W12,831 prior (-10.7%), and pre-tax profit W98.5tn versus W109.7tn prior (-10.2%). The weaker line items sit below operating profit.
4Q26E GS estimates: revenue W222.35tn, operating profit W127.24tn (up from W119tn previously), operating margin 57%.

FY26E GS estimates: revenue W723.0tn (new) vs W705.5tn (old), EPS W44,815 (new, basic) vs W45,302 (old), EBITDA W433.0tn. FY27E EPS W78,942 (new) vs W75,682 (old). FY28E EPS W90,409 (new) vs W89,428 (old).
Company guidance for 4Q26: DRAM bit shipments up mid-to-high teens% qoq and NAND up mid-teens% qoq.
Shareholder return: remaining 2026 funds of W55tn to W75tn, with details due at the Jan. 2027 Board meeting. GS expects about W70tn (about W40tn dividends, about W30tn buyback and cancellation).

trade_ideas.description: Buy Samsung Electronics common (005930.KS) and preferred (005935.KS), both on the conviction list, 12m TPs W500,000 and W380,000
trade_ideas.rationale: Strong memory fundamentals, HBM execution and an expected meaningful buyback and cancellation.
trade_ideas.risk: Major deterioration in memory supply/demand, sharp contraction in smartphone margins, and mobile OLED market share loss.

risk_factors: Shareholder return could be delayed or smaller than GS expects, given the negative share price reaction to the lack of a buyback announcement

tension_points.bull_case: GS expects the company to announce about W30tn of buyback and cancellation plus about W40tn of dividends at its Jan. 2027 earnings call, given W55tn to W75tn of remaining 2026 return funds.
tension_points.bear_case: Shares fell 4% against KOSPI -1% because no buyback was announced at the 3Q26 results, and specific execution plans are deferred to the Jan. 2027 Board meeting.
tension_points.what_invalidates: No buyback and cancellation announced at the Jan. 2027 Board meeting or earnings call.
